# Ramirez Hospitality Group
> Operator-led hospitality consulting and remote revenue management for independent hotels, boutique properties, and small hotel groups.

## About

Ramirez Hospitality Group (RHG) is a hospitality consulting practice founded by Adam Ramirez, a Palm Springs, California-based hotel operator with 10+ years of experience opening, repositioning, and managing independent and boutique hotels.

Adam Ramirez has:
- Opened 8 hotels from concept to ribbon-cutting
- Repositioned 4+ distressed or transitioning properties
- Managed $10M+ in annual hotel revenue
- Led teams of 120+ across multiple properties
- Delivered $1.5M Year 1 at The Paloma Resort, +$1M revenue lift at Twist Palm Springs, $750K on six keys at Limón Palm Springs

Properties worked with include: The Paloma Resort, Twist Palm Springs, Limón Palm Springs, Sands Hotel & Spa, Dunes Palm Springs, Stardust Palm Springs, Creekstone Inn, Bellevue Oasis, Float Palm Springs, Saguaro Hotel.

Press coverage includes: Travel & Leisure, Condé Nast Traveler, Forbes, Modernism Magazine.

## Services

### 1. Hotel Revenue Management Subscription
Flat-fee, month-to-month revenue management for independent and boutique hotels.

**Essentials** — $850/month
- For 10–40 key properties (inns, motels, small boutiques, owner-operators)
- Daily pricing management driven by AI + operator oversight
- Comp-set monitoring + weekly rate-parity audit across all OTAs
- Monthly 30-minute revenue strategy call
- OTA content scoring + listing optimization
- Direct-booking starter kit

**Growth** — $1,500/month
- For 30–80 key boutique and independent hotels
- Everything in Essentials, plus:
- Full OTA performance optimization (Expedia, Booking.com, Hotels.com)
- Direct booking strategy (metasearch, website CRO, CRM integration)
- Loyalty and rewards program development
- Group sales playbook (basic)
- Bi-weekly 60-minute strategy calls

**Enterprise** — $2,500/month
- For 80+ key properties, small portfolios, and management companies
- Everything in Growth, plus:
- Full RMS build-out (Hotelitix, Duetto, or Light House)
- Full group sales playbook with advanced displacement analysis
- Quarterly on-site visits
- Portfolio-level dashboards
- Direct involvement in annual budget process

All tiers are month-to-month. No long-term contracts.

### 2. Hotel Openings & Reopenings
Concept to ribbon-cutting in 90–270 days. Services include brand positioning, pre-opening budget and pro forma, tech stack selection, OTA and distribution setup, hiring plan, SOPs, marketing launch, soft opening, and 90-day stabilization sprint.

### 3. Hotel Technology Consulting
PMS, RMS, channel manager, CRM, keylock, and HR/operations system selection, integration, and ongoing management. Tools deployed include: Hotelitix, Duetto, Light House, Mews, SiteMinder, Revinate, Salto, 7shifts.

### 4. Hotel Operations & SOPs
Front-of-house and back-of-house SOP development, staffing, training programs, and service standards.

### 5. Hotel Renovations & Construction Oversight
Owner's-rep oversight for FF&E, capex, contractor selection, and renovation management.

### 6. Hotel Asset & Acquisition Advisory
Due diligence, distressed turnaround, and exit preparation for hotel owners and investors.

### 7. Full-Property Event Production
Brand activations and full-property event production. Past clients include Hugo Boss, Levi's, NYX Cosmetics, BMW, Volkswagen.

## Free Property Audit

Ramirez Hospitality Group offers a complimentary 45-minute property audit for independent hotel owners and operators. The audit covers:
1. OTA health score (Expedia, Booking.com, Hotels.com)
2. Pricing pressure test with live comp-set analysis
3. Direct-booking diagnostic
4. Tech-stack review
5. Top three highest-impact revenue opportunities for the next 90 days

Written follow-up delivered within 48 hours. No sales pitch.

Schedule at: https://ramirezhospitality.com/audit
